item.text:
### ISSUE-1: Binary preview path never parses PDF/DOCX content
- Category: bug
- Severity: critical
- Problem: The new 2-step preview flow sends raw base64 for `.pdf`/`.docx` files into `/api/books/split`, and that route runs chapter detection directly on the string. For the main book formats, preview is operating on base64, not extracted text, so chapter detection and OCR are effectively bypassed.
- Evidence: [src/components/UploadModal.tsx:58](/D:/Project/udemy-app/src/components/UploadModal.tsx#L58), [src/components/UploadModal.tsx:69](/D:/Project/udemy-app/src/components/UploadModal.tsx#L69), [src/components/UploadModal.tsx:81](/D:/Project/udemy-app/src/components/UploadModal.tsx#L81), [src/components/UploadModal.tsx:351](/D:/Project/udemy-app/src/components/UploadModal.tsx#L351), [src/components/UploadModal.tsx:354](/D:/Project/udemy-app/src/components/UploadModal.tsx#L354), [src/components/UploadModal.tsx:357](/D:/Project/udemy-app/src/components/UploadModal.tsx#L357), [src/app/api/books/split/route.ts:51](/D:/Project/udemy-app/src/app/api/books/split/route.ts#L51). The OCR-backed parser exists only in [src/lib/parse-book.ts:27](/D:/Project/udemy-app/src/lib/parse-book.ts#L27) and is not used by the split route.
- Suggested fix: Parse binary files server-side inside `/api/books/split` by decoding base64 and calling `parsePdf`/`parseDocx` before `detectChapters()`. Reuse the OCR-backed `parsePdf()` there so preview and final ingestion share the same parsing path.

### ISSUE-2: Closing the modal leaks temporary book records
- Category: edge-case
- Severity: high
- Problem: Closing the modal resets local state but does not delete the stub book created for preview. If the user closes via overlay/ESC/“Đóng”, the database can retain orphaned empty books, and the in-flight analyze request can still commit stale preview state afterward.
- Evidence: [src/components/UploadModal.tsx:152](/D:/Project/udemy-app/src/components/UploadModal.tsx#L152), [src/components/UploadModal.tsx:153](/D:/Project/udemy-app/src/components/UploadModal.tsx#L153), [src/components/UploadModal.tsx:154](/D:/Project/udemy-app/src/components/UploadModal.tsx#L154), [src/components/UploadModal.tsx:330](/D:/Project/udemy-app/src/components/UploadModal.tsx#L330), [src/components/UploadModal.tsx:348](/D:/Project/udemy-app/src/components/UploadModal.tsx#L348), [src/components/UploadModal.tsx:364](/D:/Project/udemy-app/src/components/UploadModal.tsx#L364), [src/components/UploadModal.tsx:423](/D:/Project/udemy-app/src/components/UploadModal.tsx#L423), [src/components/UploadModal.tsx:425](/D:/Project/udemy-app/src/components/UploadModal.tsx#L425), [src/components/UploadModal.tsx:465](/D:/Project/udemy-app/src/components/UploadModal.tsx#L465).
- Suggested fix: Route all close paths through the same cleanup logic as “Quay lại”, await deletion of any created stub, and guard `handleAnalyzeBook` with cancellation/abort logic so it cannot commit state after close.

### ISSUE-3: Book-only endpoints can mutate or delete arbitrary courses
- Category: security
- Severity: high
- Problem: The new book routes only verify that a course ID exists; they do not verify that it is actually a `book` created by this flow. That allows unrelated courses to be split, confirmed, or deleted if their IDs are passed in.
- Evidence: [src/app/api/books/split/route.ts:43](/D:/Project/udemy-app/src/app/api/books/split/route.ts#L43), [src/app/api/books/split/confirm/route.ts:30](/D:/Project/udemy-app/src/app/api/books/split/confirm/route.ts#L30), [src/app/api/books/route.ts:59](/D:/Project/udemy-app/src/app/api/books/route.ts#L59), [src/app/api/books/route.ts:67](/D:/Project/udemy-app/src/app/api/books/route.ts#L67).
- Suggested fix: In all three routes, load the course and reject unless `contentType === "book"`. For deletion, add an explicit “stub/pending” flag instead of inferring safety from `lessonCount === 0`.

### ISSUE-4: OCR conversion uses the full backing buffer instead of the PDF slice
- Category: bug
- Severity: high
- Problem: `pdf-to-png-converter` is called with `pdfBuffer.buffer`, which is the whole underlying `ArrayBuffer`, not the exact byte range of the PDF. For pooled Node buffers, that can include unrelated bytes and cause OCR parsing failures.
- Evidence: [src/lib/ocr.ts:60](/D:/Project/udemy-app/src/lib/ocr.ts#L60).
- Suggested fix: Pass the exact slice with `pdfBuffer.buffer.slice(pdfBuffer.byteOffset, pdfBuffer.byteOffset + pdfBuffer.byteLength)` or create a fresh `Uint8Array` from the buffer before calling `pdfToPng`.

### ISSUE-5: A single OCR init failure can poison OCR for the lifetime of the process
- Category: edge-case
- Severity: medium
- Problem: If `createWorker()` fails once, `_workerInitialising` is never reset. Every later OCR request reuses the same rejected promise, so OCR remains broken until restart.
- Evidence: [src/lib/ocr.ts:18](/D:/Project/udemy-app/src/lib/ocr.ts#L18), [src/lib/ocr.ts:22](/D:/Project/udemy-app/src/lib/ocr.ts#L22), [src/lib/ocr.ts:24](/D:/Project/udemy-app/src/lib/ocr.ts#L24), [src/lib/ocr.ts:29](/D:/Project/udemy-app/src/lib/ocr.ts#L29), [src/lib/ocr.ts:33](/D:/Project/udemy-app/src/lib/ocr.ts#L33).
- Suggested fix: Add rejection cleanup around worker creation so `_workerInitialising` is cleared on failure before rethrowing, allowing later requests to retry initialization.
